content_sections.heading: District Hospital Nanded Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for District Hospital Nanded Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Medical Officer (Specialist) posts at District Hospital Nanded is scheduled for 15 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Medical Officer (Specialist) posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Medical Officer (Specialist) positions at District Hospital Nanded. These include 1 Gynecologist and 4 Anesthetists.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a Postgraduate Degree/Diploma in the relevant specialty. MBBS is also considered if specialists are unavailable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the candidates applying for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 58 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the available information.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer (Specialist) positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 85,000 to Rs. 90,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for District Hospital Nanded Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on Merit and an Oral Interview. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate), and a duly filled application form if required.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any online application process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview. There is no online application process. Candidates need to report directly to the venue on the interview date.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the District Hospital Nanded located?
faq.answer: District Hospital Nanded is located in Nanded city, Maharashtra. The exact venue for the walk-in interview will be detailed in the official notification.
